# Oluwanifemi Osunsanya

Senior Product Designer, Product Builder, and Product Strategist based in Lagos, Nigeria.

Oluwanifemi Osunsanya (also known as Olu Osunsanya) designs and builds digital products that solve complex operational problems. He specializes in fintech, B2B SaaS, operational software, internal tools, AI products, and design systems.

Unlike traditional product designers, he works across product strategy, UX, frontend implementation, and AI-assisted development. He regularly ships production-ready interfaces using React, TypeScript, Node.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL.

He has over four years of experience designing products across banking, payments, insurance, healthcare, and SaaS, helping startups move from ideas to shipped products.

Currently building MomentOS, a full-stack celebration automation platform, as the sole product designer and engineer.

### MomentOS

Founder, Product Designer, and Engineer.

MomentOS is a celebration automation platform that helps individuals and organizations automate birthdays, work anniversaries, weddings, milestones, gifting, reminders, and personalized communication.

Designed and built end-to-end by Oluwanifemi using React, TypeScript, Node.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL.

## Design Philosophy

Oluwanifemi believes great products are measured by outcomes rather than visuals.

His work focuses on simplifying complexity, reducing operational friction, designing scalable systems, and shortening the distance between product ideas and production.

He believes product designers create the most value when they understand users, business, engineering, and AI equally well.
